values: Canonical tracker seeded from the current code checkout. Update this workbook as the user-story test/fix/retest loop progresses.
As a writer, I want the app to open into a usable workspace when the bundled SampleVault exists.
On first appearance, WorkspaceStore.bootstrap opens ~/Desktop/markdown/SampleVault if it exists and no workspace is already open.
Build/run smoke plus app launch observation
Direct executable opens a visible window; LaunchServices-opened staged .app remains zero-sized
As a new user, I want a clear empty state with an open-folder action when no file is selected.
EditorContainerView shows EmptyWorkspaceView when selectedFile is nil, with an Open Workspace button wired to openWorkspacePanel.
Code audit: EditorContainerView shows EmptyWorkspaceView when selectedFile is nil
As a user, I want to choose a folder as my Markdown workspace.
Toolbar, menu, and empty-state actions open an NSOpenPanel configured for directories only.
Code audit: toolbar, commands, and empty state call openWorkspacePanel
As a user, I want app metadata to stay in a sidecar and be created automatically.
Opening a workspace calls VersionHistoryStore.prepare, creating .pagepacket/history and .pagepacket/shares.
Regression runner opened temp workspace and verified sidecar-backed behavior
As a user, I want the sidebar to list all Markdown files in the chosen workspace.
reloadFileList recursively enumerates non-hidden .md files, excludes .pagepacket and .graft paths, and sorts by relative path.
Regression runner verified recursive Markdown discovery and sidecar exclusion
As a user, I want each Markdown file to show a title and relative path.
SidebarView renders file.title and file.relativePath with doc icons in the Markdown section.
Code audit plus regression file discovery: SidebarView renders file title and relative path
As a user, I want selecting a file to load its text and matching history.
load(file:) snapshots dirty current text first, then updates selectedFile, editorText, lastLoadedText, clears banners, and refreshes snapshots.
Regression runner verified first sorted file selection and text load
As a writer, I want a full editor for the selected Markdown file.
Edit mode renders MarkdownEditorView with file title, relative path, image/save actions, and TextEditor bound to editorText.
Final app screenshot shows editor surface
As a writer, I want the app to distinguish saved from unsaved text.
isDirty compares editorText with lastLoadedText; StatusStrip shows Saved or Unsaved with different icons/colors.
As a writer, I want Save to persist the current Markdown file.
saveCurrentDocument snapshots before save, writes editorText to selectedFile.url, updates lastLoadedText, marks watcher clean, reloads file list, and refreshes snapshots.
Regression runner verified save writes editor text and snapshots pre-save disk text
As a writer, I want optional autosave on each edit.
When autosaveEnabled is true and editorText changes while dirty, MarkdownEditorView calls saveCurrentDocument.
Code audit: MarkdownEditorView saves on editorText change when autosaveEnabled and dirty
As a writer, I want to adjust the editor font size.
Settings stepper changes editorFontSize in the 12...24 range; TextEditor uses that value for a monospaced font.
Code audit: Settings stepper binds editorFontSize 12...24 and editor uses that font size
As a writer, I want Edit, Split, and Preview modes.
ContentView toolbar picker binds to editorMode; EditorMode has edit, split, preview cases.
Code audit: toolbar picker and menu actions still bind Edit, Split, and Preview modes
As a writer, I want to edit and preview side by side.
Split mode uses HSplitView with MarkdownEditorView and MarkdownPreviewView, each with a 360px minimum width.
Code audit: Split mode still renders editor and preview panes side by side
As a reader, I want Markdown headings to render visually by level.
MarkdownRenderer parses # headings up to level 6; MarkdownPreviewView maps levels to heading sizes.
Final app screenshot shows rendered heading hierarchy
As a reader, I want paragraph text and inline Markdown to render cleanly.
Non-special lines become paragraph blocks; MarkdownInlineText attempts AttributedString(markdown:) and falls back to plain text.
Final app screenshot shows readable paragraph and inline Markdown rendering
As a reader, I want block quotes to stand apart from body text.
Lines beginning with > become quote blocks shown with a lavender left rule and secondary text style.
Final app screenshot shows quote block styling
As a reader, I want unordered list items to render as bullets.
Lines beginning - or * become unorderedItem blocks rendered with a teal circle icon.
Final app screenshot shows unordered list bullets
As a reader, I want ordered list numbers to match the Markdown source.
Current preview parses ordered items but renders every item with the literal label 1.
Regression runner verified ordered numbers 3 and 10 survive parsing
As a reader, I want checked and unchecked tasks to show their state.
Lines beginning - [ ], * [ ], - [x], * [x], - [X], or * [X] become task blocks with square/checkmark icons.
Final app screenshot shows checked and unchecked task rows
As a reader, I want fenced code blocks to preserve monospaced text and language labels.
Triple-backtick fences become code blocks; the optional fence suffix is uppercased as a label.
As a reader, I want pipe tables to render as rows and cells.
A pipe row followed by a separator row becomes a table; cells are normalized to header width.
Final app screenshot shows table rendering
As a reader, I want local Markdown images to display from relative paths.
Image syntax becomes image blocks; Preview resolves paths relative to the selected file folder and displays NSImage if present.
Sample image file exists and preview path resolution remains relative
As a reader, I want broken image links to be visible.
If NSImage cannot load the path, Preview shows a pink Missing image label with the path.
Code audit: missing image branch renders a labeled fallback with the unresolved path
As a reader, I want --- and *** to render as dividers.
Trimmed lines equal to --- or *** become horizontalRule blocks.
Regression runner verified stable unique block IDs for repeated rules/content
As a user, I want repeated Markdown blocks to render predictably without SwiftUI identity collisions.
Current MarkdownBlock.id is content-derived for most blocks and random for horizontalRule, so repeated identical content can collide and rules churn identity.
Code audit plus app log observation
Regression runner verified stable unique block IDs
As a writer, I want to import an image and insert Markdown for it.
Toolbar/editor image actions open an image NSOpenPanel; ImageImportService copies the file under assets/<document-name>/ and appends Markdown to editorText.
Regression runner verified nested image Markdown is ../assets/... not absolute
As a writer, I want to create a checkpoint without saving new content.
Toolbar, menu, and History plus button call snapshotCurrentDocument with reason Manual checkpoint and source Pagepacket.
Regression runner verified snapshot creation path through save/manual snapshot store path
As a writer, I want history to explain itself before snapshots exist.
HistoryView shows No snapshots yet when workspace.snapshots is empty.
Code audit: HistoryView renders No snapshots yet when snapshot list is empty
As a writer, I want snapshots to show source, reason, timestamp, byte count, and restore.
HistoryView renders each VersionSnapshot displayTitle, reason, formatted timestamp, byte count, and Restore button.
Regression runner verified snapshots are collected and available for restore
As a writer, I want to roll back to a previous snapshot.
restore reads snapshot content after front matter, snapshots current text first, writes restored content to disk, updates lastLoadedText, marks clean, and refreshes snapshots.
Regression runner verified restore writes snapshot body only
As a writer, I want snapshots for different files to stay separate.
Current safeName can map different relative paths to the same history folder, such as a/b.md and a__b.md.
Regression runner verified a/b.md and a__b.md use different history folders
As a writer, I want disk edits from tools to appear when I have no local unsaved edits.
FileWatcher detects modified selected file; if editor is clean, WorkspaceStore reloads disk text, updates lastLoadedText, shows a reload banner, updates agent status, and refreshes snapshots.
Code audit: clean selected-file external change reloads disk text, banner, status, and snapshots
As a writer, I want a conflict warning when disk changes arrive while I have unsaved local edits.
If isDirty is true, handleExternalChange snapshots the base, shows an External edit detected banner, and marks the Codex agent as Conflict.
Code audit: dirty selected-file external change snapshots base and raises conflict banner/status
As a writer, I want to accept the disk version during an external-change conflict.
Use Disk calls reloadSelectedFromDisk, snapshots before accepting, replaces editorText/lastLoadedText with disk content, clears the banner, and refreshes snapshots.
Code audit: Use Disk calls reloadSelectedFromDisk and replaces editor text with disk content
As a writer, I want to keep my local version during an external-change conflict.
Keep Mine calls saveCurrentDocument and clears the banner, writing local editorText to disk.
Code audit: Keep Mine calls saveCurrentDocument and clears the conflict banner
As a writer, I want to dismiss the external-change banner.
The xmark button sets externalChangeBanner to nil.
Code audit: banner xmark sets externalChangeBanner to nil
As a writer, I want the app to notice when another Markdown file changes.
When FileWatcher sees a nonselected file, handleExternalChange reloads the file list and updates the first agent status/detail to Changed.
Code audit: nonselected external changes reload file list and update agent status to Changed
As a writer, I want to disable external-change surfacing.
Settings toggles externalChangeDetectionEnabled; handleExternalChange returns early when disabled.
Code audit: externalChangeDetectionEnabled guard exits before surfacing changes
As a user, I want to show or hide the inspector.
Toolbar Inspector button and View menu shortcut toggle workspace.isInspectorVisible.
Code audit and final screenshot: toolbar/menu toggle inspector visibility
As a user, I want History, Share, and Agents panels in the inspector.
InspectorView segmented picker switches between HistoryView, ShareView, and AgentsPanel.
Code audit: InspectorView segmented picker switches History, Share, and Agents panels
As a user, I want to see agent activity and the CLI sync contract.
AgentsPanel renders static AgentActivity rows and commands for status, snapshot, apply, and the local skill.
Code audit and final screenshot: agent activity/status strip are rendered
As a user, I want invited collaborators to appear in the Share panel.
ShareView renders workspace.invites with email, role, compose, and remove actions.
Regression runner verified persisted invites load without example seed data
As a user, I want to add an email invite intent with a role.
addInvite currently appends non-empty email text with selected role and writes invites.json.
Regression runner verified invalid and duplicate invites are rejected
As a user, I want Viewer, Commenter, and Editor roles.
InviteRole has viewer, commenter, and editor cases; ShareView uses a segmented picker.
As a user, I want to remove stale invite intents.
removeInvite removes by UUID and rewrites .pagepacket/shares/invites.json.
Code audit: removeInvite removes by id and rewrites manifest
As a user, I want to open a mail draft for an invite.
composeEmail writes the manifest, builds a mailto URL with subject/body, and opens it through NSWorkspace.
Code audit/app observation with no send action
Code audit only; no email send action performed
As a user, I want a native settings window for editor and workspace preferences.
Settings scene shows Autosave, font size, external change toggle, and read-only sidecar/assets folder labels.
Code audit: Settings scene exposes autosave, font size, external-change toggle, and sidecar labels
As a keyboard user, I want menu actions for common tasks.
Commands add Open Workspace, Save Document, Snapshot Version, editor mode picker, and Toggle Inspector with shortcuts.
Code audit: GraftCommands wires open, save, snapshot, editor mode, and inspector shortcuts
As a developer, I want one command to build, bundle, launch, and verify Pagepacket.
script/build_and_run.sh kills Pagepacket, runs swift build, stages dist/Pagepacket.app with Info.plist/resources, opens it, and supports --verify.
./script/build_and_run.sh --verify passes process check but LaunchServices window remains zero-sized
As a user on a dark system appearance, I want Pagepacket's cream UI to keep readable dark text.
The app should force a light SwiftUI color scheme for its cream canvas and use explicit body color in editor/preview text.
Final app window screenshot shows readable editor and preview text.
As a writer, I want the before-save snapshot to recover the file version that Save overwrote.
saveCurrentDocument should snapshot lastLoadedText before writing editorText, and restoreContent should strip front matter robustly.
As a writer in split mode, I want long Markdown lines to stay visible without horizontal scrolling.
The editor should use a wrapping native text view with no horizontal scroller, preserving binding updates and autosave.
Final app window screenshot after post-fix pass
As a writer opening Pagepacket on a laptop-width display, I want the first window to show editable text without clipped split panes.
WorkspaceStore should start in Edit mode with the inspector hidden so the first launch fits the available window width; Split and Inspector remain toolbar/menu actions.
Direct executable window screenshot shows full editor text with sidebar and no clipping.
As an agent, I want usage output when I run the CLI without a known command.
PagepacketCLI.main prints usage when no command or an unknown command is passed.
As an agent, I want to inspect a vault before editing.
status prints vault path, Markdown file count, sidecar path, and up to 12 relative Markdown file paths.
As an agent, I want clear feedback when I omit the vault path.
status without args prints missing vault path.
As an agent, I want to checkpoint a file before broad edits.
snapshot <vault> <file> writes a .pagepacket/history/<safe-file>/<timestamp>.md with pagepacket front matter and source pagepacket-cli.
As an agent, I want the checkpoint reason to preserve my message.
snapshot uses --message value when provided and CLI checkpoint otherwise.
As an agent, I want to register a completed external edit.
apply <vault> <file> writes a snapshot reason Applied external edit by <author> with source set from --author or agent.
CLI apply smoke from first loop
As an agent, I want to list checkpoints for a file.
history <vault> <file> lists snapshot IDs from the file history folder sorted newest first.
Final CLI history smoke and SampleVault legacy-history compatibility check
As an agent, I want a clear no-history message.
history prints No snapshots for <file> when the history folder is missing or unreadable.
As an agent, I want status to count only user Markdown files.
Final CLI status ignored .pagepacket hidden file
As an agent, I want snapshots for similarly named paths to stay separate.
Current CLI safeName shares the same collision risk as the app history store.
Final CLI collision smoke wrote separate folders
As an agent running against /tmp or symlinked folders, I want status output to show clean workspace-relative paths.
status should normalize vault and file URLs before deriving relative paths so /private/tmp does not leak into output.
Final CLI smoke printed a/b.md, a__b.md, and root.md.
As a tester, I want SampleVault to exercise common Markdown features.
SampleVault/welcome.md contains heading, paragraphs, lists, tasks, quote, table, code fence, CLI examples, and image syntax.
SampleVault rendered in final app screenshot and code/file audit
As a tester, I want the sample image link to resolve.
SampleVault/welcome.md references assets/welcome/graft-sample.ppm, and that file exists.
As a developer, I want README features to match current code.
README describes the SwiftUI app, edit/preview/split, local history, image import, invites, inspector agent activity, CLI, and build/run integration.
README audited against current app/CLI scope
As an agent, I want the repo-local sync skill to describe the safe Markdown edit loop.
skills/graft-sync/SKILL.md instructs status, snapshot, direct Markdown edits, apply, and stopping on conflicts.

values: Ordered-list preview hardcodes every item as 1.
MarkdownPreviewView renders orderedItem with Text("1.") regardless of the Markdown source number.
Preview block identity is duplicate or unstable
MarkdownBlock.id is content-derived for most blocks and UUID-generated for horizontal rules, causing duplicate-ID risk and unstable identity.
Nested-document image import can insert an absolute path
ImageImportService computes the inserted path by replacing the selected file's parent path. For nested docs, assets live at the workspace root, so the replacement can fail.
Share panel starts with fake invites and does not load persisted invite manifest
WorkspaceStore seeds maya@example.com and reviewer@example.com for every workspace and never reads .pagepacket/shares/invites.json on open.
Invite input accepts invalid and duplicate emails
addInvite only rejects empty trimmed text, so invalid strings and duplicate invite records are accepted.
History safeName can collide across different relative paths
Replacing slash with __ and dot/space with _ maps distinct paths to the same folder, risking mixed snapshots.
Tests/BrandingTests exists but has no files, so app behavior coverage depends on smoke scripts/manual validation.
Added Tests/run_regression_checks.sh because XCTest/Testing modules are unavailable locally
Dark system appearance made text unreadable on cream canvas
The app used cream backgrounds while inheriting dark-mode default text, producing white text on light surfaces.
Forced light SwiftUI color scheme and explicit body text color where needed.
Status printed /private-prefixed pseudo-relative paths for /tmp vaults
The CLI compared unresolved /tmp vault paths against enumerated /private/tmp file paths, so replacement failed.
Normalize URLs before deriving relative paths.
Restore could write snapshot front matter into the Markdown file
restoreContent only stripped front matter for one exact delimiter shape and failed on snapshots without the extra blank line.
Parse through the closing front-matter delimiter and consume any following newlines.
Before-save snapshots stored the new editor text instead of the overwritten disk text
saveCurrentDocument called snapshotCurrentDocument after editorText changed, so rollback to the pre-save file was impossible.
Editor pane could remain horizontally scrolled on long Markdown lines
The split editor could show clipped line starts for long Markdown lines, making the editable Markdown hard to scan.
Replaced TextEditor with a wrapping NSTextView bridge that disables horizontal scrolling.
Hand-staged .app opened by LaunchServices stays at a zero-sized placeholder window
The freshly built executable opens a visible Pagepacket window, but /usr/bin/open on dist/Pagepacket.app still produces only zero-sized Pagepacket windows in this environment.
Tried disabling restoration, AppKit lifecycle, early window creation, Info.plist restoration keys, and ad-hoc signing; direct executable launch remains the working path.
Default split/inspector startup could clip content at 1120px
Launching directly into Split with inspector visible over-constrained the window on the available display, clipping editor and preview content.
Start in Edit mode with inspector hidden; Split and Inspector remain explicit controls.
